title: Paon Main Bediya Pehne
body:
Paon Paon mein bediyaan pehney
Huwe bimaar chala
Mera bimaar chala
Sar jhukaye huwe Sarwar (as) ka azadaar chala
Mera bimaar chala
Tauq se jaqda kaheen
Aur kaheen durroan ki saza
Har sitam Sehta huwa ..
Dee bachaney ke liye
Deen ka sardaar chala
Mera bimaar chala
Maaein behnein sarey bazaar.
Rasan basta hain
Haay aazurda hain.....
Bain karta huwa Iss
Gham mein giraftaar chala
Mera bimaar chala
Saath hain Ehle haram (sa)
Sar pe ridaayein bhi nahi
Zulm kartey hain laeen....
Khoon aankhon se bahata
Huwa qhuddar chala.
Mera bimaar chala
Chill gaye chaley lahoo
Behney laga zakhmoan se
Ashqe gham aankho se...
Raahe purkhaar pe Shabbir (as) ka dildaar chala
Mera bimaar chala
Bediyaan Paon mein
pad padke buka karti hain.
Ye sada karteen hai....
Shaan e aslaaf liye
Sahibey qirdaar chala
Mera bimaar chala.
Tegh khainche huwe lakhon
The sitamgaar magar
Phir bhi bekhauf o khatar..
Misley Abbas Alamdar (as)
Woh jidaar chala
Mera bimaar chala.
Warmm hai pairoan pe aur
Khaq padi hai sar mein.
Kyoun na fariyaad karey....
Haay kis haal mein wo
Beqaso lachaar chala.
Mera Bimaar chala.
Aik ek gaam pe aati thi
Sada ye Gauhar
Marhaba shey ke pisar...
Deen qadmoan se terey
Jaanib e deedaar chala
Mera bimaar chala
Sar jhukaaye huwe sarwar
Ka azaadaar chala
Mera bimaar chala
Paon mein bediyaan
Pehney
Huwe bimaar chala
Mera bimaar chala.
